CVE-2026-129301.title: mail-parser: One hostile attachment aborts `write_attachments()` and silently drops the rest of the batch
CVE-2026-129301.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.3, write_attachments() calls _safe_attachment_filename() and write_sample() without isolating failures for individual attacker-controlled MIME parts. An RFC 2231 filename containing a NUL, a basename exceeding NAME_MAX, or an undecodable base64 payload can raise ValueError, OSError, or binascii.Error and abort the entire save loop. Later attachments remain unwritten; when a caller catches only MailParserError, the failure is not surfaced through the expected library-exception path. If a downstream scanner or sandbox reads only the extraction directory, a payload after the crafted part can be missed even though it remains in the delivered message, and the aborted batch also causes availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

CVE-2026-133760.title: Nested Short Ternaries Make the Nesting Check of the Expression Parser Exponential, Letting Untrusted Expressions Hang It
CVE-2026-133760.description:
The fix for CVE-2026-109449 made the expression parser check the nesting level of long expressions. This check exists since Symfony 5.4.54, 6.4.48, 7.4.21 and 8.1.9. The parser builds a ?: b with the node of a used twice, and the check walked every path to every node. With nested short ternaries, the number of paths doubles at each level, so an expression of 256 bytes never finished parsing.

The expression needs no variable and no function. Any code that parses or lints untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. evaluate() and compile() parse the expression first, so they hang too.

The nesting check now skips the nodes it already checked, so it takes linear time again. evaluate(), compile() and the messages of runtime errors now use the node of a once, so a is evaluated once, as in PHP.

CVE-2026-84172.title: Apache Wicket: Component markup is served as a package resource when wicket-core has its own class loader
CVE-2026-84172.description:
Files accessible to external parties in Apache Wicket.

org.apache.wicket.markup.html.PackageResourceGuard decides whether a file on the classpath may be streamed to a client as a package resource. HTML is on the default allow list, so the only thing that separates a static HTML file, which may be served, from a component's markup template, which may not, is a check for a class file of the same name beside it. That check calls getResource() on the class loader that loaded wicket-core. The resource itself is reached through different class loaders: the scope class is resolved through the application's IClassResolver, which uses the thread context class loader, and org.apache.wicket.core.util.resource.ClassPathResourceFinder#find() then tries the scope class' own loader, the context class loader, and the wicket-core loader last.

Where wicket-core is loaded by a class loader that cannot see the application's classes, the check finds no class file, concludes the file is not a component…

CVE-2026-87043.title: sys_rand_get() silently returns an unwritten buffer when the entropy device is not ready

The entropy-device random number generator in subsys/random/random_entropy_device.c returned early with -ENODEV from rand_get() as soon as device_is_ready() failed, before reaching the non-cryptographic system-timer fallback further down the same function. Because z_impl_sys_rand_get() returns void and discards that error — and the public sys_rand_get() syscall is itself declared void, so it cannot report failure — the caller's output buffer was left untouched and its previous contents were handed back as random data. The thin wrappers make this a plain uninitialized read: sys_rand32_get() declares uint32_t ret;, calls sys_rand_get(&ret, sizeof(ret)) and returns ret.

The "not ready" state is a normal runtime condition rather than a fault. CVE-2026-99633.title: drm/amdgpu: keep the CS user fence BO in GTT
CVE-2026-99633.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdgpu: keep the CS user fence BO in GTT

The CS ioctl hands the GPU the GART address of the user fence BO, but
since the BO keeps its own preferred and allowed domains, it no longer
makes sure the BO is in GTT. A user fence in a VRAM BO, which only needs
to be a page in size, gets its address from amdgpu_bo_gpu_offset(), which
warns about non-contiguous VRAM. On navi31, a CS with a user fence in a
4K VRAM BO, or in one created with AMDGPU_GEM_CREATE_VM_ALWAYS_VALID:

WARNING: amdgpu_object.c:1531 at amdgpu_bo_gpu_offset+0x86/0xb0 [amdgpu], CPU#11: cs_gem_checks/18393
RIP: 0010:amdgpu_bo_gpu_offset+0x86/0xb0 [amdgpu]
Call Trace:
<TASK>
amdgpu_cs_parser_bos.isra.0+0x4eb/0x850 [amdgpu]
amdgpu_cs_ioctl+0x97e/0x2510 [amdgpu]
drm_ioctl_kernel+0xac/0x110 [drm]
drm_ioctl+0x2c6/0x5b0 [drm]
__x64_sys_ioctl+0xa0/0xf0
do_syscall_64+0xa3/0x4d0
entry_SYSCALL_64_after_hwframe+0x76/0x7e

and BOs which can't be in GTT at all,…

hwmon: (peci/dimmtemp) Fix devres leak and UAF on concurrent unbind

When a peci_dimmtemp device is unbound concurrently with its delayed
initialization work (detect_work), newly allocated devm resources and
the hwmon device are leaked, leading to a use-after-free when reading
the lingering hwmon sysfs attributes.

devm_delayed_work_autocancel(). During driver detach, devres_release_all()
first moves all existing entries from dev->devres_head onto a local todo
list before invoking their release callbacks in reverse order. If
create_dimm_temp_info_delayed() is already running when

create_dimm_temp_info() can allocate dimmtemp_label strings via
